content:
maria: Seeing a P99 latency spike tied to the model swap at ~11:02 UTC. model-opt-3.2 promoted and p99 jumped from ~180ms -> ~720ms on several hosts. Any obvious suspects?
infra-bot: deploybot: canary -> prod promotion for model-opt-3.2 completed by rollout-engine at 2026-03-18T11:02:10Z :rocket:
jin: I pulled perf histograms. Tokenizer change in 3.2 increased avg token count per request (~+25%). KV cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 64% for affected shards. Seems like cache fragmentation + seqlen shift.
maria: ugh. do we have profiler traces? kernel selection logs? :thinking_face:
tim: I grabbed a simple perf trace on host i-rt-54a. Kernel-decider logs show fallback from optimized-fused-attn -> generic-matmul for sequences > 384. The new tokenizer pushes many requests past that threshold, so we're hitting a slower path and larger memory working set. snippet: ```kernel_selector: selected="generic-matmul" seq_len=412 reason="threshold_exceeded" host=i-rt-54a```
eva: also seeing CPU steal spikes on same hosts around the window. But the tenants running 3.2 had larger batch sizes too (tenant-D increased batching by ~2x). Could be noisy neighbour compounding the kernel path change. attached small top dump: ```PID USER %CPU COMMAND
2345 tenantd 78.3 python serve.py
9876 redwood 12.1 runtime_worker```
jin: two-pronged: rollback 3.2 to 3.1 for prod, and throttle tenant-D batching limits. I'll open rollback and rate-limit policy. Also we should add a seqlen regression test for tokenizer changes.
maria: please do rollback. starting incident doc and notifying CS. :warning:
infra-bot: deploybot: rollout start: rollback model-opt-3.1 -> prod at 2026-03-18T11:27:05Z by jin
ops-sre: After rollback latency baseline restored within ~3 minutes. Confirmed p99 back to ~190ms. Postmortem actions: [1] adjust kernel-decider thresholds to avoid mid-range flips when tokenizer drift expected; [2] add automated seqlen distribution check during model onboarding; [3] add KV cache warmup / prefetch when vocab/tokenizer changes increase subtoken expansion; [4] add tenant batching guardrails in Dedicated.
maria: recorded follow-ups and assigned owners. Thanks team — good catch on the tokenizer -> kernel selector interaction.
